project_type: Next.js 14 App Router full-stack app with custom WebSocket signaling server
build_system: Next.js 14.2.18 with custom server entry (server.ts compiled via ts-node --project tsconfig.server.json). Two tsconfigs: tsconfig.json (esnext/bundler for Next.js app) and tsconfig.server.json (commonjs for server.ts). next.config.ts uses module.exports = withPWA(nextConfig) — NOT export default — because next-pwa 5.x requires CommonJS exports.
test_framework: Vitest 1.6.0 with @testing-library/react 16.0.0 and jsdom 24.1.0. Config in vitest.config.ts (to be created). Run with: npm test
verification_instructions: 1. npm run type-check (must be clean). 2. npm test (all unit/integration tests pass). 3. npm run build (Next.js build succeeds, generates PWA service worker in public/). 4. npm run dev (custom server starts on port 3000, WebSocket available at ws://localhost:3000).
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/sw.js and public/workbox-*.js are generated by next-pwa during `npm run build`. They are gitignored. Do NOT hand-write them.
environment_constraints: server.ts uses CommonJS (tsconfig.server.json). The Next.js app files use ESM-compatible imports. RTCPeerConnection is browser-only — NEVER import or reference it in server.ts or any file included by tsconfig.server.json. next-pwa must exclude /api/* from caching (add urlPattern exclusion). PORT defaults to 3000.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow standard Next.js 14 App Router conventions. All client-interactive components must have 'use client' directive. Server components must not import ws, WebRTC globals, or browser-only APIs.
key_patterns: 1. next.config.ts: module.exports = withPWA(nextConfig) pattern (already correct). 2. Tailwind: colors use primary.DEFAULT (#6366f1), success (#22c55e), danger (#ef4444). Font aliases: font-sans, font-mono. 3. Path alias @/* maps to ./src/*. 4. Session tokens: JWT signed with SESSION_SECRET env var via jsonwebtoken. 5. UUIDs: use uuid v4 from 'uuid' package. 6. File size limit: MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB env var (default 100). 7. Session expiry: MAX_SESSION_MINUTES env var (default 60).
directory_structure: c:\OnlineCopyPaste.net\ is the workspace root. All source goes in src/. src/app/ = Next.js App Router pages and API routes. src/components/ = React components. src/hooks/ = custom React hooks. src/lib/ = shared utilities (session, webrtc, content-detection, etc.). src/types/ = shared TypeScript types. tests/ = vitest tests (unit/, integration/). public/ = static assets and PWA manifest. server.ts = custom HTTP+WebSocket server at root level.
